card.q: How do I get an EMSI card?
card.a: Sign up in the app – your digital card is activated instantly. If you already have a plastic card, you can link it under “Card”.

wallet.q: Can I add the card to Apple Wallet / Google Wallet?
wallet.a: Yes – under “Card”, tap “Add to Wallet”. No third-party apps needed.

pay.q: How do I pay at the pump?
pay.a: Under “Pay”, choose the pump, fuel and amount, then confirm – the pump unlocks. No need to go inside; the receipt appears in the app.

hold.q: Why does my bank reserve a larger amount?
hold.a: With “Full tank”, up to €150 is temporarily reserved. Only the fuel you take is charged and the rest is released automatically.

plate.q: How does pay by plate work?
plate.a: Register your car and turn the feature on. When you drive up, the camera recognises your plate and unlocks the pump; your default card is charged.

wash.q: How long is a wash code valid?
wash.a: 14 days from purchase. You can send the code to a friend.

stamps.a: You get a stamp every time you buy coffee with your EMSI card. Collect 5 and your 6th coffee is free.

fleet.q: How do I use a company card?
fleet.a: Under “For business”, link your account with the company code and PIN. When paying, choose “Company”, the vehicle and enter the odometer reading.

data.q: How do I delete my data?
data.a: In Settings → “Privacy and data” you can get a copy of your data or delete your account.
